summary.tldr: Lets the government call a referendum on electoral reform and hold it at the same time as a general election.
what_it_does: Allows the Governor in Council to call a referendum on a question about reform of Canada’s electoral system.
Allows a referendum to be held at the same time as a general election.
Changes the Act’s long title to say it covers referendums on the Constitution of Canada and electoral reform.
Keeps the rule that referendum writs must be dated no later than the 36th day before polling day.
